statements.t: Fiscal 2026 results reflect growing traction from the Company’s investments in its Enterprise North America go-to-market model, where full-year invoiced amounts increased 4% and deferred revenue increased 17%, supporting the Company’s outlook for revenue and Adjusted EBITDA growth in fiscal 2027 .
The Company’s consolidated revenue for Q4 FY2026 was within its updated guidance range at $70.0 million compared with $71.2 million in Q4 FY2025.
The Company’s consolidated revenue for FY2026 was within updated guidance at $261.5 million compared with $267.1 million in FY2025.
These increases reflect growing client commitments and give us greater visibility into revenue we expect to recognize in fiscal 2027.

Jessi Betjemann, Chief Financial Officer, said, “We delivered fourth-quarter and fiscal 2026 revenue within our updated guidance range and full-year Adjusted EBITDA within both our original and narrowed guidance ranges, while strengthening our cost structure and continuing to invest in growth.
As a larger base of contracted commitments translates into reported revenue, we expect to benefit from operating leverage, with fiscal 2027 Adjusted EBITDA growing faster than revenue.”

The Company expects revenue and Adjusted EBITDA to grow in FY2027, supported by the growing volume of client commitments, increased invoiced amounts in Enterprise North America, and services bookings generated during FY2026.
As this activity converts into reported revenue over time, the Company expects improved profitability.

As previously announced, the Company entered into a definitive agreement to transition its direct operations in China to a locally owned licensee partner, with closing expected by the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2027.
